verdict.rationale: Calendly documents an official MCP server that agents can connect to. It translates natural-language requests into Calendly API calls, uses Dynamic Client Registration so no OAuth app needs to be pre-registered, and publishes a supported-tools reference (e.g., event type creation mapped to POST /event_types); a probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that the MCP server works in practice.
